general.title: L2P Analysis (Single)
general.instructions:
All input data uses mount name 'deg_table'. Attach your dataset with mount name 'deg_table' to replace the demo.

- **(blank)**: auto-detects a single flat file or RDS from mount 'deg_table'
- **Table**: same as blank - auto-detects a flat file from mount 'deg_table'
- **Filtered DEG**: MOSuite moo-properties asset (mount 'deg_table') - after 'filter differential expression'
- **All DEG** (default): MOSuite moo-properties asset (mount 'deg_table') - after 'differential expression analysis'

Set 'Comparison' to the comparison ID to analyze. Configure Basic Settings and run.

datasets.name: Demo DEG Table
datasets.help_text: Mouse RNA-seq demo data (var_DEGAnalysis.rds) with comparisons B-A, C-A, C-B. Used automatically if no file is uploaded.

parameters.name: DEG Table File
parameters.description: Input mode. All modes read from mount 'deg_table'. Attach your dataset with mount name 'deg_table' to replace the demo data.
parameters.help_text:
Blank / Table: auto-detect a flat DEG table (CSV/TSV/RDS) from /data/deg_table/.

Filtered DEG: MOSuite moo-properties asset at mount 'deg_table'. Loads analyses/diff_filt.csv - filtered genes, all comparisons combined. Use after 'MOSuite - filter differential expression' capsule.

All DEG: MOSuite moo-properties asset at mount 'deg_table'. Loads diff_{comparison}.csv for the selected Comparison. Use after 'MOSuite - differential expression analysis' capsule.

parameters.name: Comparison
parameters.help_text: Which comparison to analyze (e.g., 'B-A', 'C-A', 'Treatment-Control'). Must match column prefix in your DEG table

parameters.name: Species
parameters.help_text: Gene annotation species. Non-human genes will be converted to human orthologs

parameters.name: Pathway Collections
parameters.help_text: Comma-separated pathway collections: GO, REACTOME, KEGG, PANTH, PID, BIOCYC, WikiPathways, H, C1-C8 (MSigDB). Leave blank if using only custom pathways

parameters.name: Gene Name Column
parameters.help_text: Override auto-detected gene name column (e.g., 'Gene', 'symbol'). Leave blank to auto-detect

parameters.name: Ranking Column
parameters.help_text: Override ranking column if not named '{comparison}_tstat'. Leave blank to auto-detect

parameters.name: Significance Column
parameters.help_text: Override significance/p-value column if not named '{comparison}_pval'. Leave blank to auto-detect

parameters.name: Fold Change Column
parameters.help_text: Override fold change column if not named '{comparison}_FC'. Leave blank to auto-detect

parameters.name: Select By Rank
parameters.help_text: Select genes by rank (recommended) or by significance/fold change thresholds

parameters.name: Select Top Percentage
parameters.help_text: Select top percentage of genes (vs fixed number)

parameters.name: Select Top Genes

parameters.name: Significance Threshold
